title: Chapter 1037
paragraphs: Chapter 1037
Episode 249. The First Deployment of the Plutonian (4)
Of course, Vahn's voice did not fully reach the enemies deep in the Black Sea.
No matter how powerful Vahn is, it's physically impossible.
However, 'will' can be conveyed.
Sharp as a day-drawn spearhead, that will was piercing into the inner being of Nirgand, who had momentarily halted.
This time too, the Battle Kings dispersed in the same way, starting to erase the dimensional gates at the entrance of the central Black Sea.
With every flash of lightning, a dimensional gate disappeared.
When only the dimensional gate chosen by Vahn remains, they gather again and move.
From the central starting point deeper, then back to the entrance, and again to the central area.
The dimensional gates were spread out like a poorly made maze.
An inefficient structure that's hard to think was deliberately made for escape.
Vahn could understand the reason while hopping through several dimensional gates.
‘Chiron Runcandel, he formed the gates avoiding areas where his influence was strong. That's why it's all over the place.’
Just as Vahn felt the power of Nirgand from the outskirts of the Black Sea, he was feeling the energy left by Chiron.
The energy of Chiron left at the entrance, middle, and deep parts of the Black Sea was all from before he transcended Genesis once more.
It was energy diluted by time.
But even with that, Vahn could discern the kind of power 'Chiron before overcoming demonic nature' had.
"Indeed, the father of Brother Jin was a remarkable person."
"It seems there are traces of Chiron Runcandel here too, Sister Vahn."
"Yes. The traces he left will not disappear no matter how many years pass."
"What kind of power does it feel like?"
"It's the energy that only someone who has shouldered the world alone for a long time can have."
"I don't know what it is, but it's clear that even Brother Tusin is amazed by it."
"I'd like to cross swords with him at least once."
Vahn was momentarily captivated by the traces left by Chiron.
And that meant, Vahn was not as tense at the moment.
More interested in the father of a brother than the enemy.
Fzzt, kigigigigik-!
The dimensional gates kept tearing apart.
The Plutonian had already been going back and forth between the entrance, middle, and deep parts of the Black Sea about a dozen times.
Each time, the traces left by Chiron in the Black Sea became more prominent, and Vahn's newly engraved lightning energy increased.
In other words, Nirgand was running out of places to go.
He too was continually moving between the gates, but the encirclement of the Plutonian showed no signs of breaking.
Just like when he fled from Chiron recently, he was under the illusion that Vahn's sword was already at his neck.
‘It's the same as a few days ago…’
Until he met the priestess and high priest of the Sun God Religion.
Nirgand was fleeing with all his might, avoiding Chiron.
Realizing that he could 'never' win against him, it was the best choice for Nirgand to delay his demise, however pitiful.
The same goes for now.
The moment Nirgand felt Vahn's will to kill him, he immediately realized.
That she was an entity he could never oppose.
From the moment Chiron transcended demonic nature, the order and knowledge Nirgand knew were broken.
But he never thought he'd meet someone like Chiron again so soon.
[Sanna, Luke. You showed me the power left by the god of gods, telling me I have a destined future. Could this be it?]
Then a white dimensional gate opened next to Nirgand.
Sanna and Luke emerged from it, with calm expressions.
"Nirgand."
[I've been mocked...]
As soon as Nirgand saw their faces, he instantly sensed that the Sun God Religion had plotted something.
And that he was chosen as the sacrifice for their plan.
"I'm not without regret for Nirgand. But Nirgand had no other choice, did he? If we weren't there, Nirgand would have already been caught and extinguished by Chiron."
He wanted to tear Sanna apart right away.
But a piece of the god's power, the Sun God left by Sanna, was refusing it.
A massive will that even as one of the Black Sea Five Kings, he could not oppose.
"It's funny. Mortals, insignificant compared to Nirgand, sometimes suddenly overcome the real will of a god, but immortals never can."
[What have you schemed.]

"We want the piece of the Sun God's power that Nirgand harbors to bloom more widely through Nirgand. That's why we helped Nirgand to escape the realm of the Five Kings, to spread that power even to the world of humans."
Sanna had no reason to deceive or further placate Nirgand with false words.
From the moment Nirgand agreed to receive the power of the Sun God, he essentially became a slave to the Sun God Religion.
Nirgand, who had never directly experienced the Sun God, could not know this fact.
“Soon, Lord Nirgand, you will meet the Plutonian in the depths of the Black Sea. At that time, the fragment of the Sun God within you will fully bloom.”
Nirgand was already feeling the fragment of the Sun God he harbored vibrating.
This too was a matter unrelated to his will.

“Using that power, you can surely inflict deep wounds on the monsters that have threatened you so far. If you're lucky, you might even kill them...? After the fight, your remains will be left to the world. Just like Lord Gliek, your brother.”
The shining dimensional gate remained open.
Sanna and Luke turned around, preparing to return to the void of the Sun God Religion.

“Now bearing the essence of a true god, Lord Nirgand, your remains will have a greater impact on this world than Lord Gliek did. Please, become a pure land where the Sun God can bloom again. We will always pray for that.”
[Puhuhuhu... foolish ones. You are mistaken.]
As the followers of the Sun God Religion were about to enter the dimensional gate, Nirgand burst into dark laughter.
Without looking back, the two heard Nirgand's following words.
[Didn’t you just say it yourself, Sanna? Immortals cannot transcend the will of a true god, but mortals can. And here, there are two of the most terrible and massive mortals.]
Nirgand’s appearance was transforming.
Golden crystals sprouted on his massive crow-like body, and his dark eyes were also turning gold.
Sanna smiled satisfactorily feeling Nirgand’s change, but Luke felt an inexplicable unease.

[Do you really think you can predict or control them? No. You have made a mistake. It might have been easy to use me, but not them... Especially not with just a fragment like this! You will experience something beyond your handling. Perhaps even today.]
“Yes, I've heard your last words. Then, I wish you luck, Lord Nirgand.”
The Sun God Religion’s dimensional gate closed.
Nirgand continued to chuckle in his place for a while.
After all, there was no longer a reason to flee.
Nor was it possible.
With Vahn in front and Chiron behind.
Waiting for Vahn's arrival, Nirgand pondered his and his brothers' fate.
Maybe, their destiny had been determined a long time ago.
Thunder was approaching closer.
A sound of tens of thousands of thunderbolts, unheard in the Black Sea, was trampling and shaking the black land, approaching Nirgand.
A heavy vibration spread through the ground, shaking Nirgand’s body.
Raising his head, Nirgand saw in the distance a blue-white brilliance carving a path.
[I thought it would take a bit longer, but you're already here.]
“So it seems. I thought you would struggle and flee more, Nirgand. This is good for both of us.”
Vahn and the Battle Kings emerged from the intensely white-blue light.
Strangely enough, as soon as Nirgand directly faced Vahn, he felt a calming emotion engulfing him.
It was a feeling completely different from the first time he saw Chiron or when Chiron, having overcome demonic nature, tried to kill him.
For a long time, Chiron was the 'one who must become a brother' to the Black Sea Five Kings, the only means to unite their fragmented selves.
But Vahn was just an unavoidable accident, an insurmountable disaster.
Just as the kings of the Black Sea are to humans.
[Black Sea Five Kings, Nirgand.]
“Vahn, Plutonian Battle God.”
Vahn and Nirgand stared at each other for a while.
It wasn't to gauge each other's power.
Vahn was just contemplating how to deal with the power of the Sun God that Nirgand possessed, while Nirgand could only stand still.
“You hold a power that doesn’t suit you. Seems like you’ve been used by those Sun God Religion folks. So... they intended to mix it with your immense spirit and spread it to the mortal world.”
Vahn quickly understood the Sun God Religion's plan.
Otherwise, they wouldn't have tied the power of the Sun God to Nirgand in this way.
The spirit and fragment of the Sun God that Nirgand possessed were, even by Vahn's standards, sufficiently immense.
Just immensely immense.
“Brothers, tidy up the surroundings while I extinguish Nirgand. Make sure that none of the Sun God’s filthy energy or spirit leaks out.”
“Understood.”
Sreung...
Sigmund's blade slowly emerged from its sheath.
Nirgand's face was being etched on the pale blue blade.
“You need not feel wronged, Nirgand. Those who gave you that power will soon be cut by this sword as well.”
